name: pwr_currentconsumption_standby_rtc_bkpsram
description: PWR_CurrentConsumption in Standby mode with the RTC and the backup SRAM (STANDBY_RTC_BKPSRAM_MODE, the readme's sixth line): as with the RTC alone, and HAL_PWREx_EnableBkUpReg turns the backup regulator on (BRE, then BRR: PWR_CSR 0x208 in Standby) to keep the backup SRAM through Standby. The RTC's wake-up event 20.48 s after entry (0xA000 periods of LSI/16) sets WUF and ends Standby; after the reset PWR_CSR keeps WUF, BRE and BRR (0x34209 with the regulator's ready bits) and LD2 toggles every 100 ms.
